policy: Reference photographs stay outside Assets and are not included in the game. New meshes and surface patterns are authored locally; no manufacturer branding or photo pixels are copied into game assets.

references.name: Mayra's Bridal Pink garden rose
references.author: Alexandra Farms
references.license: Copyrighted photograph, visual reference only; not an imported game asset
references.observed: Broad rounded outer petals, rolled edges, densely overlapping central petals, pale outer surface and deeper centre.
references.not_verified: A complete botanical scan, every petal's geometry or the real flower's underside.
references.interpretation: Three shared low-poly bloom variations with rounded lobes and unequal rotations. Reduced petal count is a game approximation.

references.name: Washed Oxford stand collar shirt
references.author: MUJI
references.license: Copyrighted photograph, visual reference only; not an imported game asset
references.observed: Separate long sleeves, a narrow standing collar, front button placket, chest pocket, rounded hem and fine plain cotton texture on a worn shirt.
references.not_verified: Exact hanging drape without a wearer; photographed shirt is not a dry-cleaning rack reference.
references.interpretation: Original shirt, short-sleeve shirt and long coat; rack spacing, plain fabric colours and hanging folds are authored.

references.name: Linea Classic S commercial espresso machine
references.author: La Marzocco
references.license: Copyrighted photograph, visual reference only; not an imported game asset
references.observed: Metal front fascia, pressure dial, black steam valve knobs, separate group heads and handles, drainage grate and cup-warming rails.
references.not_verified: Internal boiler geometry, operation, or exact texture roughness.
references.interpretation: Generic unbranded machine with original proportions, additional service pitcher and tamper; decorative only.
